store.0: User Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics, seeks espresso machine with café-like experience for non-professionals, prefers sleek stainless-steel finish, balances advanced features with ease of use.

Michael, a first-time buyer from Seattle, interested in espresso machines with design, ease of use, pricing, shipping, dimensions, warranty, and temperature performance. Specifically concerned about drip coffee makers that don’t heat sufficiently and has had to microwave coffee. Wants to know if your espresso or drip machines have adjustable temperature settings or reliably produce hot coffee to avoid microwaving. Values consistent, high-quality brew temperature for at-home coffee experience.
